description: Side effects (console, DOM, network, non-determinism) buried inside otherwise value-returning computations - flagged as errors (external interaction breaks referential transparency the same way a mutation does). Named to avoid colliding with js-fp-review's own *.effects.* effect-boundary exception vocabulary.

_calibration.note: Both live js-fp-review runs at HEAD (2026-07-31) reported exactly 5 errors (all 5 planted effects) - the first against an earlier revision (fp-buried-effects.ts), the second against this fixture's current name/content (fp-impure-computations.ts, with readRoundedTotal/loadClampedUserScore/generateRequestId). issueCount/severities.error widened to 4-8 deliberately (min 4 tolerates one missed effect, max 8 tolerates per-statement splitting of the same effect) - do not narrow to 5-5 without re-measuring
